findings.message: .starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml names the key DEV_DB_APP_PASSWORD after an environment; a key carries no environment, its folder does (.starcistacks/<env>/secrets/): name it DB_APP_PASSWORD in every environment and seal each environment's own value (a warning for this minor: `starci app sync` prints the places to rename, and the owner seals the value under the new name with `starci app secret init` or `rotate`)

.starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml names the key DEV_DB_OWNER_PASSWORD after an environment; a key carries no environment, its folder does (.starcistacks/<env>/secrets/): name it DB_OWNER_PASSWORD in every environment and seal each environment's own value (a warning for this minor: `starci app sync` prints the places to rename, and the owner seals the value under the new name with `starci app secret init` or `rotate`)
